verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Warp publishes an llms.txt at docs.warp.co (HTTP 200) that indexes its API docs. Pages are also served as agent-friendly .md variants, and the docs state the API definition can be given to documentation-aware AI tools. missing for 10: evidence of a fuller agent-oriented bundle (e.g. llms-full.txt or a fetchable OpenAPI file, since the probed OpenAPI paths returned 404)

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.warp.co/llms.txt # Warp API Docs
give documentation-aware AI tools access to the Warp API definition
